init.description: Event-log polling (5-600s) reads the cloud log and does not wake the lock. Status polling (1-1440 min) wakes the lock, so keep it slow. The lock state is the real deadbolt: after every open the lock is checked again until the motor has locked. With auto-calibration the first 10 entries are measured with back-to-back checks (extra battery for those entries only), then the check times are set from this home's measured relock times and measuring stops. A manual first-check time overrides the automatic one.
